criteria.AC1: 默认新建任务包含 `scopePolicyVersion: 1`、可解析的 enforce scope 和自身 task-evidence 路径；旧 planning task 首次 start 时被迁移并创建快照；显式 JSON scope 可合法扩展其他路径，非法规则被定位拒绝。
criteria.AC2: 启动快照之前已有且未变化的 staged/unstaged/tracked/untracked 越界路径不会阻断；启动后新增文件、删除、修改、stage/commit、rename 或变化的 untracked 文件会被正确纳入匹配。
criteria.AC3: 允许范围内的变更在 direct native archive 与 acceptance archive 均通过；任一越界变化在两条路径均阻断，任务目录/status/pointer/自动提交均未被改变。
criteria.AC4: marker=1 task 的 snapshot 缺失/损坏/hash不符、scope 声明变更或 scope 缺失均 fail closed；无 marker 的旧 task 显示 legacy/需回填。
criteria.AC5: 有越界改动的任务运行 `task.py finish` 仍只清当前任务指针，不触发 scope gate。
criteria.AC6: tracked/index/worktree/untracked、精确/`/**` 匹配、rename 两端、既有脏状态和同路径启动后修改均有 fixture；已有 branch validation/archive evidence/autocommit 测试不回归。

checks.scope: pre-start unchanged worktree excluded and post-start tracked/index/untracked changes included

checks.scope: both archive paths share gate and block without side effects

checks.scope: fail-closed marker/snapshot/scope validation and legacy compatibility

checks.scope: finish remains a session-pointer operation without scope gate
